newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic closes Omnitel stake buy.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic closes Omnitel stake buy.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said it closed its agreement -- announced Tuesday -- to buy an 8.26 percent stake in the Omnitel Sistemi Radiocellulari (OSR) consortium from Olivetti, a member of that consortium.

Omnitel Sistemi owns 70 percent of the Italian cellular service provider Omnitel Pronto Italia -- meaning through the agreement Bell Atlantic indirectly raised its stake in Omnitel Pronto by 5.8 percent. Bell Atlantic now owns a 24.9 percent stake in the Omnitel Sistemi consortium, it said, as well as a 17.4 percent stake in Omnitel Pronto.

Bell Atlantic would pay about $265 million for the shares by the end of this year, and an extra $18.6 million by 2001 -- half of that amount by the middle of next year -- if certain conditions were met, the company said.
Omnitel Pronto expects to add more than 700,000 customers in its first year of service, Bell Atlantic said.
